check.clean: {checked}: every key, foreign key and index is where the cluster needs it.

slots: {used} of {max} project slots used on the {tier} plan

noMove.one: {count} step ({kinds}); nothing moves and writes do not pause.
noMove.other: {count} steps ({kinds}); nothing moves and writes do not pause.

moves.one: {count} cutover, about {rows} rows, about {seconds}s to copy, writes pause for about {ms} ms.
moves.other: {count} cutovers, about {rows} rows, about {seconds}s to copy, writes pause for about {ms} ms.

join.spreading: taking its share of the data
join.starting: starting as a copy of the home node

ran.notCluster: This project is not a cluster.
ran.notClusterAnyMore: This project is not a cluster any more. The database restarts once while its services move back into its pod.
ran.retrying: The cluster is trying that step again.
ran.dropped: The rest of that request was dropped. Nothing else changed.
ran.jobStarted: Job {job} started. Its progress is under Jobs.

createdJoining.one: A cluster node is on the way. It starts as a copy of the home node, then joins the cluster and takes its share of the data on its own.
createdJoining.other: {count} cluster nodes are on the way. Each starts as a copy of the home node, then joins the cluster and takes its share of the data on its own.

createdStarting.one: A cluster node is starting as a copy of the home node. Attach it once it is ready.
createdStarting.other: {count} cluster nodes are starting as a copy of the home node. Attach each once it is ready.

ran.podDeleted: The pod of {pod} is being deleted.
ran.alreadyNodes: The project already has {nodes} cluster nodes.
ran.alreadyCluster: This project is already a cluster.
ran.nowCluster: This project is a cluster now. The router and the services start in pods of their own, and the database keeps running.
ran.replicaMaking: A replica of cluster node {node} is being made from its backup. It protects the node once it is following it.
ran.replicaRemoving: The replica of cluster node {node} is being removed, and its project slot freed.
ran.noReplica: Cluster node {node} has no replica. Nothing changed.
ran.marked: Marked as seen. The alert stays open until what it is about is over.

replica.failingOver: Its replica is taking its place
replica.failoverFailed: Its replica could not take its place

blocked.firstBackup: Its first backup is not finished yet, and a replica is made from it.
blocked.noSlot: A replica takes one project slot, and all of your plan's are in use.
